facts.value: the recall-ratio criterion must require BOTH ratio >= 0.8 AND recall_home >= 0.5 absolute; a ratio alone is gamed by a do-nothing filter (recall 0 on every corpus -> ratio undefined/1.0 -> VALID everywhere). The web_hq positive control caught exactly this: home recall 3.4% means 0.8 x home = 2.7%, a band so thin that 'VALID' would certify near-total blindness. With the floor, the existing regex filter itself reads RECALIBRATE-class on its home corpus -- quality decisions live in the quality head (AUC 0.823 vs hand, dq.quality_head.auc_vs_hand), not in the regex layer.

facts.value: Five-source survey for the stage-2 MinHash hard gate. Lee 2021 (C4 360M docs): word 5-gram, Jaccard 0.8 + edit-sim 0.8, removed 3.04% C4 / 13.63% RealNews / 0.39% Wiki-40B, memorization ~10x lower, PPL equal or better. FineWeb (15T tok): word 5-gram, Jaccard 0.75, removed 44% per-snapshot (36T to 20T tokens), global iterative up to 90% rejected. Dolma (3T tok): exact URL/doc/paragraph, removed 53.2%/14.9%/18.7%; code (the Stack) MinHash settings unreported. SemDeDup: embedding cosine eps 0.03, up to 37% removed at no perf drop. D4 (600M docs): MinHash shingle/threshold unreported. Adoption rule outcome: only one <=1B source reports a Jaccard threshold (Lee 0.8); FineWeb 0.75 is 15T-scale; condition not met, stricter is 0.75, but calibration (dq.near_dedup_gate_calibration) shows neither catches the observed class.

facts.value: Calibrated on the 50-doc t24 hand-read sample (2 template clusters, 6-8 docs: Yii CRUD {3,24,30,38}, Java POJO {5,7,19,35}). Literature standard (raw word 5-gram, J 0.75-0.8) catches 0/8: Yii tops out at raw J 0.181, POJO under 0.01. Chosen gate: normalize (comments/strings/numbers/identifiers stripped, 70-word keyword stoplist), 3-word shingles, Jaccard >= 0.5, union-find, keep one per cluster. Catches 5/8 cluster docs {5,7,19,30,38} with 0 false pairs among the other 42 (nearest false pair 0.462, python-rust boilerplate). Implied removed fraction 5/50 = 10% (Wilson 95% CI 3.4-21%); the sample is language-stratified (PHP 32%) so the corpus-wide fraction is measured by 3b at re-stamp. Misses the most divergent cluster members (docs 24, 35). Normalized containment (threshold 0.77) catches the same 5 with a thinner margin (0.778 vs 0.739).

facts.boundary: A GATE THAT CERTIFIES ITS OWN NO-OP. Wiring _near_dedup_postpass up at its documented defaults today would remove approximately nothing AND stamp near_dedup: True while doing it (build_corpus.py:918-919), because the threshold is calibrated for a normaliser that was never written. The gate encodes 'the interesting case is above 0.5 under the calibrated normaliser' and neither half of that assumption holds. Same class as eff.fp8_weight_byte_cache measuring a disabled path: a check's assumption about where the interesting case lives is the one thing the check never tests. SEPARATELY: this measures near-duplication and refutes nothing about the P0 symptom -- code_rp1t is the only domain carrying meaningful near-dup, it falls off a cliff with threshold, and there is no setting at which near-dedup removes a large share of this corpus.
